title: RESULTS
universal_lens: The structural unification of market state transitions and probabilistic inference is governed by the topological mapping between discrete sign-flips in line movement and continuous Wilson confidence intervals. This establishes a rigorous boundary between genuine market drift and deterministic model artifacts.
gsi_mapping: GSI Bayesian inference maps the `by_month` aggregation directly to posterior beat rates, utilizing the Wilson score interval as a conformal prediction set. The absence of sport dimensions enforces a hierarchical prior collapse, isolating pure market-level alpha from underlying categorical noise.
gse_mapping: GSE situational reasoning models the lock-to-close trajectory as a Markovian state transition. A zero-crossing event (sign-flip) represents a critical phase shift in the betting landscape, while identical absolute magnitudes trigger an immediate artifact veto protocol.

primitives.name: Wilson Confidence Boundary Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: TOTAL deep-dive - **Decided-only beat rate:** 176/301 = **58.5%** - **Wilson 95% CI:** [52.8%, 63.9%] - **Clears 52.4% threshold:** YES - This is the only market whose decided-only beat clears 52.4%.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: k: integer count of beats; n: integer total decided picks; \hat{p}: dimensionless empirical beat rate; z: standard normal quantile (dimensionless); CI: dimensionless probability bounds.
primitives.assumptions: Picks are independent Bernoulli trials; sample size is sufficiently large for asymptotic normality approximations within the Wilson score framework.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when n approaches zero or when severe autocorrelation exists between sequential picks, invalidating the i.i.d. assumption.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's conformal prediction sets, establishing a rigorous statistical lower bound for expected value extraction.
layer2.telemetry: Percentage of markets clearing the 52.4% threshold over rolling monthly windows.

primitives.name: Zero-Crossing Sign Flip Detector
primitives.verbatim_quote: If |lock| != |close|, the runline genuinely moved through zero (real movement).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: lock line value (units of points/runs); C: close line value (units of points/runs); \mathbb{I}: dimensionless indicator function.
primitives.assumptions: Sign changes reflect true market sentiment shifts rather than data ingestion errors; lines are continuous variables discretized at capture.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails if bookmakers intentionally mirror opposing sides' lines without actual liquidity shifting across the zero-point equilibrium.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE phase-transition detection, identifying moments where aggregate market belief fundamentally reverses direction.
layer2.telemetry: Frequency of genuine sign-flips versus artifact matches per market segment.

primitives.name: Magnitude Artifact Veto Protocol
primitives.verbatim_quote: If |lock| == |close|, it's likely the lock is the wrong side's number (artifact).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: L: lock line value (points); C: close line value (points); Veto: binary flag (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Exact floating-point equality of absolute magnitudes across distinct timestamps is statistically improbable in organic markets.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Invalidated in highly illiquid markets where lines remain static and perfectly mirrored due to lack of trading volume.

layer2.mapping: Functions as a GSE data-integrity filter, purging synthetic noise before calculating true market impact metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Ratio of vetoed picks to total sign-flips (e.g., 3/57 in spot checks).
